description: This file defines the main activity of an Android application that implements a flashlight with a ViewPager interface, managing multiple fragments including white light and party light modes.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Primary activity managing the flashlight interface with a ViewPager rotating between fragments.

classes.name: LightFragmentAdapter
classes.description: Adapter class managing fragments in the ViewPager.

classes.name: WhiteLightFragment
classes.description: Fragment displaying a white light layout.

classes.name: PartyLightFragment
classes.description: Fragment managing party light effects, capable of starting and stopping cycling animations.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the ViewPager with fragments, and manages page change events.

methods.name: addFragment
methods.description: Adds a fragment to the adapter's list and updates the ViewPager.

methods.name: getItem
methods.description: Returns the fragment at a specified position in the adapter.

methods.name: getCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of fragments managed by the adapter.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the layout for the respective fragments.

methods.name: startCycling
methods.description: Starts the party light cycling animation.

methods.name: stopCycling
methods.description: Stops the party light cycling animation.
